description: This header file defines classes and interfaces for managing virtual socket (vsock) connections, including client and server variants, with asynchronous I/O capabilities and JSON message handling in the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

classes.name: VsockConnection
classes.description: Abstract base class providing interface for vsock connection handling, including connection management, data transfer, and messaging.

classes.name: VsockClientConnection
classes.description: Derived class implementing client-side vsock connection logic.

classes.name: VsockServerConnection
classes.description: Derived class implementing server-side vsock connection logic, including server shutdown capabilities.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Establishes a vsock connection to a specified port and CID, possibly with a vhost user CID.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Terminates the vsock connection.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to establish a connection, returning a future that indicates success.

methods.name: SetDisconnectCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be invoked upon disconnection.

methods.name: IsConnected_Unguarded
methods.description: Checks connection status without locking.

methods.name: IsConnected
methods.description: Checks connection status with thread safety.

methods.name: DataAvailable
methods.description: Checks if data is available to read.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a single data element, blocking until data is available.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data into a provided buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads a specified amount of data into a vector.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads data of specified size.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message into a buffer.

methods.name: ReadMessage
methods.description: Reads a message and returns it as a vector.

methods.name: ReadMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a message.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessage
methods.description: Reads a JSON formatted message.

methods.name: ReadJsonMessageAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a JSON message.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes raw data from a character buffer.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data from a vector.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes a string message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes data from a vector as a message.

methods.name: WriteMessage
methods.description: Writes a JSON value as a message.

methods.name: WriteStrides
methods.description: Writes data with specified strides.

methods.name: ServerShutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server connection.
